name: AddressNC
description: AddressNC has been prioritized by the North Carolina Geographic Information Coordinating Council (GICC) as a critical framework dataset. The AddressNC Program runs parallel to and is derived from the North Carolina 911 Board Next Generation 911 (NG911) Program.  Address data has been identified as mission critical for validation and accurate call routing within NG911 and AddressNC completes a full-circle approach of address maintenance and sustainability through applied enhancements and quality control beyond 911 requirements.  A primary goal of AddressNC is to continually develop and maintain quality address points on a continuous cycle through updates published in NG911. Various agencies in federal, state, and local government can benefit by applying practical applications of quality addressing in their own programs, negating the need to rely on outdated statewide addressing data and/or using paid address data sets from third party sources.
